title: Staying Consecrated in the Place God Calls You
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares the importance of consecration in the life of a believer and a church member, highlighting the dangers of allowing the devil to distract us from our calling and God's plan. Pastor Zehner encourages listeners to stay committed to their church and ministry, even when faced with challenges and corrections from their leaders. By listening to this sermon, you'll be inspired to surrender your life to God's will and stay focused on His purpose for your life.
